# ModuVilla - Prefabricated Housing & Outdoor Pergola Manufacturer

> Official website of Yaodeni Guan Prefabricated Housing Technology Co., Ltd., a manufacturer specializing in modular prefab homes, expandable container houses, and motorized aluminum pergolas for global export.

## Core Product Lines
- [ModuVilla - Modular & Expandable Houses](https://moduvilla.com/#products): Double-wing expandable container houses, integrated modular cabins, and flat-pack prefab homes.
- [CoveCore - Mobile & Space Capsule Houses](https://moduvilla.com/#products): Modern mobile living units and resort space capsules.
- [AluVilla - Outdoor Aluminum Pergolas](https://moduvilla.com/#products): Motorized louvered courtyard pergolas and outdoor sunrooms.

## Company & Contact
- [Official Homepage & Company Profile](https://moduvilla.com/): 20,000 sqm manufacturing facility located in Qingdao, China.
- [Direct Inquiry & Contact](https://moduvilla.com/#contact): Export sales, custom design, and global shipping support.
